text:
Marta (People Ops): quick thread — offer exception request for converting contractor Priet Sharma to full-time. Need comp-band uplift, prorated equity, and benefits alignment around payroll freeze week. Can we route? Packet: https://redwood-internal/hr/offers/priet-2026
Dev (Hiring Manager): Priet has been driving our model caching infra as a contractor. Recommend L4->L5 provisional with base move $125k -> $145k, prorated RSU: 50% of annual grant vesting at hire, remainder standard schedule. Candidate wants to start 2026-11-01. Payroll freeze that week may delay benefits start to 12/01 — request bridging stipend for employee portion.
Ola (Recruiter): candidate verbally accepted pending comp & benefits. Contractor conversion needs retro start date handling and equity tax advice.
Ben (Finance): need GL and total one-time costs. Anything over $15k uplift to be routed to comp committee. Also payroll freeze note: if hire falls within payroll freeze, benefits activation will be delayed unless we provision retroactive coverage; finance needs amount to reserve.
Marta (People Ops): numbers: 
```
Proposed provisional base: $145,000 (from $125k)
Sign-on: $12,000 (paid 50% at start, 50% at 6mo)
Prorated equity: 50% of 2027 grant vested immediately (~$22,500 est)
Bridging stipend: employee contribution capped $350 for month of delayed benefits (max 1 month)
GL: 6101.1600, budget owner: eng-ml
Rationale: continuity on caching infra, high ramp cost if delayed
```
CompLead (Comp Committee): please attach peer comps and manager justification. We'll review but can fast-track if docs are complete and uplift is at policy threshold.
Legal (Legal): recommend adding contractor-to-employee conversion clause and tax advisory note for accelerated equity. Also suggest 12-month clawback on sign-on and accelerated equity if voluntary departure. Template uploaded.
hr-bot: policy reminder: "Contractor conversions with uplift >$10k require Comp Committee review" (HR-CONV-003). Template: /templates/contractor-conversion-amend.docx
Ola (Recruiter): uploaded comps and manager note: https://redwood-internal/docs/comp/priet-peers-2026.xlsx
Ben (Finance): provisional budget ok pending comp committee + legal text. Reserving $40k one-time for sign-on + equity; recurring costs to be reflected in next quarterly forecast.
CompLead (Comp Committee): approved (fast-track) with note: provisional for 60 days, review at 45 days for permanent placement. Added requirement: manager to submit 45-day performance checklist.
Legal (Legal): signed off on conversion clause and clawback language; added tax withholding guidance.
Marta (People Ops): routing summary: comp-committee -> finance -> legal -> VP Eng final signoff (verbal in DM). Target to send offer today 13:30 PT. Ola to confirm candidate acceptance and conversion paperwork.
Dev (Hiring Manager): thanks — please include clause about prior contractor stockless period and explicit effective hire date.
Ola (Recruiter): will send offer and note bridging stipend if payroll freeze delays benefits.
Marta (People Ops): closing note: once signed, HR will upload conversion documents and schedule 45-day review reminder. Thanks all :thumbsup:
